name: Pre-Commissioning, Commissioning and Start Up Management incl calibration & lab test (lube oil)
description: OEM commissioning-service descriptions, remote pre-commissioning case histories, Malaysian service presence and printed used-oil laboratory limit values. No published fee schedule for commissioning management or oil-analysis laboratory tests was found.
aliases: Pre-Commissioning, Commissioning and Start Up Management incl calibration & lab test (lube oil)

specifications.metric: MAN PrimeServ commissioning and after- — maintenance/service levels
specifications.basis: MAN PrimeServ 'Prepare for MAN 175D', printed copyright '1510-0287-04ppr June 2022': L1 operational checks, L2 basic maintenance (oil change/filters), L3 advanced checks, L4 intermediate overhaul, L5 major overhaul.

specifications.metric: MAN PrimeServ commissioning and after- — standard and advanced training duration
specifications.basis: Same MAN brochure, printed June 2022: 'Four-day training for Standard and Advanced courses, and four weeks training for the Expert course at the MAN PrimeServ Academies in Denmark.'

specifications.metric: MAN PrimeServ commissioning and after- — service centre network
specifications.basis: MAN brochure printed June 2022: 'Via a network of over 100 service centers worldwide, MAN PrimeServ provides 24/7 service across the globe.'

specifications.metric: MTU used-gas-engine-oil analysis (labo — oil sampling interval, Series 4000 gas engines
specifications.basis: MTU Fluids and Lubricants Specifications A001072/02E, printed 2020-06: 'oil samples must be taken every 250 op. hrs. and analyzed' for Series 4000 generator/marine gas engines; fixed intervals without analysis only after consultation with MTU.

specifications.metric: MTU used-gas-engine-oil analysis (labo — used oil viscosity at 100 C, Series 4000 / Series 400
specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E printed 2020-06, Table 2 'Limit values for used gas engine oils SAE 40': viscosity at 100 C ASTM D445 / DIN 51562, max 17.5 (Series 4000), min 11.5; new oil value +30% limit also printed.

specifications.metric: MTU used-gas-engine-oil analysis (labo — used oil total base number minimum
specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E printed 2020-06, Table 2: TBN ASTM D2896 / ISO 3771 min 2.5 and TBN > TAN; also 'new oil value -60%'.

specifications.metric: MTU used-gas-engine-oil analysis (labo — used oil water content maximum
specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E printed 2020-06, Table 2: water ASTM D6304 / EN 12937 / ISO 6296 max 0.2 vol% for both Series 4000 and Series 400.

specifications.metric: MTU used-gas-engine-oil analysis (labo — wear element iron limit
specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E printed 2020-06, Table 2: Fe DIN 51399-1/-2 max 30 (Series 4000) / max 50 (Series 400); results of oil analyses must be archived.

specifications.metric: Wärtsilä Malaysia Sdn Bhd — years since Malaysia establishment
specifications.basis: Wartsila.com/mys page read 25 Nov 2026: 'Wärtsilä in Malaysia was set up in 1996 in Kuala Lumpur, and today it has over 15 professionals in 2 different locations in Kuala Lumpur and Pasir Gudang, Johor to serve our customers in the East and West Malaysia.' Page carries a 9 Feb 2022 news item.

gaps.what: Pre-Commissioning, Commissioning and Start Up Management incl calibration & lab test (lube oil)
gaps.why: No published man-day rate, commissioning-management fee, calibration fee or oil-analysis laboratory price list was found. MTU prints analytical limit values but no test price.
gaps.next_action: Request priced commissioning-management and laboratory-test quotations; record MTU limits as technical basis only, not cost.
